name: Claire
title: Candle Square
description: The Senior Maid of Candle Square and acting Master Maid. She values plans and principles, and always prepares for every possible unexpected situation.
introduction:
The Senior Maid of Candle Square and acting Master Maid.
With a personality that values plans and principles, Claire always prepares for every possible contingency.

She firmly believes that those who serve the Saviors at Candle Square must always uphold dignity and honor as models for others, and therefore despises any sign of dishevelment. The maids of Candle Square and even the Saviors themselves are immediately scolded if they show the slightest lapse before her.
Though Claire is regarded as the very embodiment of a model Candle Square maid, a rumor once spread that <color=#2A80D8>she had been seen among a group of delinquents in the past</color>. However, given her conduct and the rumor's lacking credibility, it was swiftly dismissed.
Yet, she is unusually knowledgeable about bike hogs, which are often stereotyped as being ridden only by rough people.

After receiving an invitation to the Journey, she briefly questioned whether she was worthy to accept it, but decided to participate according to her belief <color=#2A80D8>that a maid of Candle Square must always serve as an example to all</color>.
